summary: cisco.ios now requires ansible.netcommon >= 8.1.0 for ansible-core 2.19 compatibility and ansible-core >= 2.16.
questions: Which ansible.netcommon version does cisco.ios need with ansible-core 2.19?
What is the minimum ansible-core for cisco.ios?

answer_card.title: cisco.ios dependency bumps
answer_card.answer_md: cisco.ios now depends on **ansible.netcommon >= 8.1.0** (earlier versions had issues with ansible-core 2.19) and requires **ansible-core >= 2.16**.
